title: Failed Gmail check gives no reason or fix
detail: The Gmail check header shows a red "Failed" pill. The box below it says "Completed with warnings: The run recorded warnings, with no line about them in its log or report." The pill and the box disagree, and nothing says the Google sign-in was revoked or offers a way to reconnect.
impact: Gmail tracking has stopped and the person is told only that there were unexplained warnings.
